result_preview.title: Chemical Inventory Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages chemical substance records and regulatory documentation across manufacturing and procurement operations.
result_preview.description: Enables tracking and administration of chemical materials used in production and supply chain activities. Maintains substance registration, hazard classifications, and location-based inventory details. Supports regulatory reporting, safety audits, and compliance verification for occupational health and environmental protection requirements across enterprise facilities.

result_preview.title: Hazardous Substance Regulatory Validation API
result_preview.shortDescription: Validates hazardous substances against regulatory requirements and compliance standards.
result_preview.description: Exposes hazardous substance data for real-time regulatory validation against global compliance frameworks. Retrieves substance classifications, regulatory thresholds, and restriction status to ensure materials meet current safety and environmental standards. Manages substance compliance attestation and provides access to regulatory change notifications.
useCases: Compliance ensures new product materials meet global safety regulations before manufacturing
